content:
iPhone 18 Pro will be unveiled next week, and a reliable leaker on Weibo has posted a new thread listing three new colours expected to make their debut.

iPhone 18 Pro may come in three all-new colours, with no repeat from last year

At next week's September event, Apple will reveal all the details of its new flagship iPhone models.

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will launch alongside the iPhone Ultra. Rumours have already revealed plenty to look forward to.

Colour often seems to be one of the last details Apple finalises. But this year, the consensus across the board is that the flagship will swap Cosmic Orange for a deep cherry/wine red, and add silver and sky blue.

Reports are divided on whether Apple will offer a black/space grey option this year.

However, a new post from Weibo leaker 'Fixed Focus Digital' points to a slightly different colour lineup. He predicts:

  • Deep cherry/wine red
  • Sky blue
  • Black

The leaker says silver is 'very unlikely' to launch, adding in a follow-up post that he has seen no evidence of the model. If this lineup holds, it would mean Apple replacing every colour of the iPhone 17 Pro with an entirely new one.

Sky blue has already been used on the iPhone Air and MacBook Air, and the blue on both is very pale. In everyday light it looks more like silver. So Apple may be hoping sky blue will serve as the ideal alternative for buyers who prefer silver.

Many users were disappointed last year that the iPhone 17 Pro came without a black or space grey option. So here's hoping the latest leak is accurate and black makes its return on the iPhone 18 Pro.

Which of these iPhone 18 Pro colour options would you buy? Let us know in the comments.
